#### G) Compliance & Risk Form Examples (Comply)

We’ll keep this informational. The goal is reducing risk, not collecting “everything.”

Examples (compliance/risk):

1. Consent form

1. Waiver/release form

1. Data/privacy request intake (DSAR)

1. Safety inspection form

1. Incident + corrective action form

1. Policy acknowledgement form

1. Whistleblowing/reporting form (anonymous option where appropriate)

High-level guidance:

- collect the minimum needed

- separate marketing consent from terms acceptance

- document retention and access internally

#### H) Research & Feedback Form Examples (Learn)

These forms are about decision-quality learning, not “nice comments.”

Examples (research/feedback):

1. Product feedback form

1. Customer satisfaction survey (CSAT)

1. NPS survey

1. Post-event evaluation form

1. Employee engagement survey

1. Usability test screener form

1. Market research questionnaire

1. Course/training evaluation form

If you want a big library of example categories (more for browsing than strategy), template galleries like Jotform’s can help spark ideas (Jotform templates library).
